basic_info.description: 274 Collingwood Street is a beautiful and classic Edwardian condo overlooking the Castro. Spectacular views of downtown and the city from the living room are framed by an expansive picture window. The open concept kitchen, dining and living room is perfect for entertaining. The three bedrooms offer flexibility and enough space for a home office. The full bathroom has been recently updated and the primary suite includes an en-suite half bathroom and a walk-in closet. The laundry room opens to the back stairs leading to the lush backyard which is shared with only two other owners. Additional storage in the basement, high walk and transit scores, and a serene location round out this exceptional home.
